items.title: Governance compliance beyond the catalog in Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker provides rich governance signals such as metadata forms, data quality scores, glossary coverage, and subscription data, but they live in separate APIs. This post shows how to join them into a single enriched Iceberg table and build a compliance scorecard you can query, score, and adapt to your governance policy.
items.creator: Amom Luiz
